notes: Ids are copied from the last printed swagger path segment. access_path is the printed origin + basePath + path. No MET id was written onto a datanorge row.
Fetch GETs the stored collection URL. Observation values are printed feature name. Nested arrays such as collection and geometry coordinates are not copied as dimensions.
License is the printed swagger CC BY 4.0 URL. Publisher stays null: the spec does not print a publisher field.
